title: CT: explain and map the 35, 60 and 64 manual-check revisions
public_pr_body:
Adds tests/validation/MANUAL-35-VS-64.md with exact counts from actual file revisions and one table mapping all 64 expanded IDs to immutable original/refreshed/expanded file lines. Original #248 has 35 G01–G08 rows; Code f76a5b84 has 60 after G00/G09–G14 additions; builder #289 has 64 after four G15 transfer gates. All original IDs remain.

Explains the user's 35/64 references without inventing Rhys's signed scope choice or treating the readable 60-row refresh as 64. Manual counts are distinct from VSR protocol counts. Missing Operations Pack and unsigned scope remain visible; choosing a form does not waive cutover conditions.

Checks: 35/60/64 unique IDs, subset relationships, exact additions and all 64 immutable source-line links verified. Documentation only; no runtime/approval, docs/signoff duplicate, SQL, main merge or Ready label.

- [x] Count discrepancy explained and every expanded row mapped
- [ ] Rhys/Code record approved exact revision and actual results
